hooks.command: RAVEL_PROJECT_DIR="$(ravel_start="$PWD"; ravel_dir="$ravel_start"; while :; do if [ -f "$ravel_dir/.claude/settings.json" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$ravel_dir"; break; fi; if [ "$ravel_dir" = / ]; then git -C "$ravel_start" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\n' "$ravel_start"; break; fi; ravel_dir="$(dirname "$ravel_dir")"; done)"; if [ -f "$RAVEL_PROJECT_DIR/.ravel/hook-runtime.sh" ]; then . "$RAVEL_PROJECT_DIR/.ravel/hook-runtime.sh"; fi; if [ -d "$RAVEL_PROJECT_DIR/src/ravel" ]; then export PYTHONPATH="$RAVEL_PROJECT_DIR/src${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"; fi; "${RAVEL_PYTHON:-python3}" -m ravel.workflow.host_guards --host codex --phase pre --project "$RAVEL_PROJECT_DIR"; RAVEL_GUARD_STATUS=$?; [ "$RAVEL_GUARD_STATUS" -eq 0 ] && exit 0; echo "BLOCKED: RAVEL host guard refused or is unavailable" >&2; exit 2
